text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 54 Rivercrest Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the appeal of the Order to Comply, dated July 24, 2020, for 54 Rivercrest Road, Folder No. 20 171908 PRS 00 IV until its meeting on March 22, 2021 and directed the Appellant to have the property line staked, and to provide evidence of the property line, submitted at least one week in advance of the March 22, 2021 meeting.
